source_binding: SHA-256 of exact saved Native actor rows and two-lane, two-direction road readback

events.left_of_center_entry: first frame with any ego body width extending above Native centerline y=0
events.full_left: first frame with entire ego body width above centerline
events.abreast: first overlapping longitudinal body extents of ego and same-direction overtaken actor
events.pass_return: first frame after full longitudinal overtake with ego body wholly right of centerline
events.oncoming_gap: opposing actor body rear minus ego body front in the saved longitudinal frame
events.clear_sight: saved driver-eye visible flag and measured clear distance throughout left phase

time_uncertainty: one 50 ms frame bracket; no subframe event or physical sightline claim
spatial_uncertainty: synthetic longitudinal body gap uses 2.2 m half-length per actor; actual Native bounding boxes and road geometry require readback

fallback_routing.fallback1: measured entry oncoming body gap < 100 m routes to delayed left entry
fallback_routing.fallback2: measured minimum pre-return oncoming body gap < 20 m routes to shorter exposure request
fallback_routing.fallback3: any saved driver-eye sightline flag false during left-of-center phase routes to abort and rejoin request
fallback_routing.interpretation: engineering routing triggers on source-bound saved observations; thresholds do not establish statutory sufficient distance or safety

statutory_limit: No numeric sufficient-distance threshold is stated in the frozen text; safe operation, actual interference, highway status, hill-crest sightline and legal verdict remain pending original evidence and review
